passive.name: Living Battery
passive.text: Zeri's Attacks deal magic damage and are treated as Abilities. Moving and casting Burst Fire stores up energy in Zeri's Sparkpack. When fully charged her next Attack deals bonus damage.

spells.name: Burst Fire
spells.text: Burst Fire shoots a burst of 7 rounds that deal attack damage to the first enemy hit. This Ability is treated as an Attack.

spells.name: Ultrashock Laser
spells.text: Zeri fires an electric pulse that slows and damages the first enemy hit. If the pulse hits a wall it expands into a long range laser.

spells.name: Spark Surge
spells.text: Zeri dashes a short distance and energizes Burst Fire to pierce through enemies. She will vault and grind over any terrain she touches.

spells.name: Lightning Crash
spells.text: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity and overcharges herself, gaining increased damage and stacking Move Speed that refreshes and gets stronger every time she hits an enemy champion. While overcharged, Burst fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains lightning between enemies.

damage.value: Zeri deals magic damage with her Attacks and can sustain damage with repeated Burst Fire hits.

archetype.value: Zeri is an ADC whose attacks require precise aiming and movement.

axis.value: Zeri plays lane patiently before level 6 rather than forcing fights.

winCondition.value: Zeri wins by collecting resources, positioning well, and taking over fights as she scales.

spikes.why: Zeri can start looking for all-in opportunities after respecting her earlier weakness.
Zeri gets stronger by farming consistently and reaching her items.
Zeri’s next Attack deals bonus damage.

mistakes.value: Zeri players make a mistake when they force plays instead of using her mobility wisely.
